WARN  lint-spa-poll-no-recovery  @DIR@/src/rc/index.html:14  setInterval/setTimeout poll loop 'poll()' reloads, but the recovery is not keyed on time since the last success (no lastOk* timestamp set from a clock in the poll body and compared) -- a failure-count or reload-on-error watchdog is blind to a hung request; key it on lastOkAt (types/dashboard.md Poll loop reliability)
-- stderr --
-- src/rc/index.html --
<script>
let lastOkAt = Date.now();
function watchdog() {
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 30000) { location.reload(); }
}
async function poll() {
  try {
    await readJson();
    paint("live");
  } catch (err) {
    paint("error");
  } finally {
    watchdog();
    setTimeout(poll, 5000);
  }
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
</script>
